description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1305/15 of 09.09.2003 by Pelmadulla D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing a particular land parcel to be acquired for public purpose. It contains detailed land description (lot number, name, extent, location) and procedures for compensation claims, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
